title: statespace run record, version 1
description: One recorded tool execution in the runs registry, runs/<RUN-id>.json (spine section 9.5; ARCHITECTURE.md section 9.1). Copy cites it as {{run:RUN-id}} and documents as [X RUN-id]; GATE-numbers requires those citations and GATE-runs resolves them and checks this record's integrity. A record is identified by its path, so it carries no schema tag. Field names are snake_case, the form every W0 record uses; spine section 9.5 writes the same fields in camelCase (binarySha256, inputSha256, recordedAt), and runs/README.md maps the two. Every value is copied from the execution's own output or computed from files on disk, never typed from memory. A value that the execution did not record is null, and an imported record (origin imported) names each such field in unrecorded with the reason. The root stays open: an engine adds its own fields (checks, values, probes and so on) beside the core, which this schema types.

id.description: The run's ID from the spine, RUN-{kebab}. GATE-runs requires it to equal the file name.

title.description: One line saying what the run establishes, in plain words.

task.description: The task that recorded the run, such as W0-S11.

origin.description: recorded: the task executed the run and wrote this record from its outputs (the default when absent). imported: the run executed earlier and this record registers it from the logs on disk in research/; its null core fields are listed in unrecorded.

records.description: What the run records, as the spine's table of executed runs states it (spine section 9.5, the Records column).

engine.description: The engine that ran, such as z3, cvc5, lean, tlc, postgres, pglite or chromium.

version.description: The engine's version, verbatim as it printed it (for example 5.3.1, 1.4.2-modified or 2026.10.20.183001).

version_string.description: The engine's whole version line, verbatim, when it says more than the version (a commit, a build, a platform).

binary.description: What binary_sha256 is the hash of: the binary, jar, wheel or archive that ran. Null when no single file ran (per-configuration hashes are then under configs).

binary_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the binary, jar, wheel or native library that ran. Null when the execution did not record it or no single file ran.

image.description: The container image as name@digest, or the browser build for a browser run. Null when the run used no container, or the execution did not record its image.

started_at.description: When the execution started: a date-time, or only a date when the execution recorded no time of day. Null when not recorded.

duration_s.description: Wall-clock duration of the execution in seconds. Null when not recorded.

argv.description: The exact command line, flags included, one element per argument; for a run made of several commands executed in order, one such list per command. Null when the execution did not record it; such a run is re-run with argv before copy cites its numbers (spine section 9.5).

inputs.description: The files the run read (specs, scripts, configurations, archives), each with its SHA-256 at execution time.

budget.description: The budget and limits the run had: rlimit, workers, seeds, state caps, timeouts, container memory. The bus Budget shape where it applies (ARCHITECTURE.md section 5.8); empty when the run had none.

workers.description: TLC's -workers value, or another engine's worker count.

exit_code.description: The process exit code. Recorded, never read alone: the verdict comes from verdict_lines. Null when not recorded.

verdict_lines.description: The lines that carry the verdict, copied verbatim from the tool's output (paths normalised to repository-relative paths or <sandbox>).

outputs.description: The files that hold the run's output, each with its SHA-256 and size. A recorded run's outputs live under runs/<RUN-id>/; an imported run's outputs are the logs in research/.

values.description: Named values parsed from the outputs, which copy can print with a value reference, {{run:RUN-id#values.<name>}}.

environment.description: Where the run executed. Null fields were not recorded.

os.description: The operating system and kernel, such as Linux 6.12.63.

cpu_count.description: Logical CPUs available to the run.

ram_gib.description: Memory of the host in GiB.

cpu_architecture.description: The CPU architecture, such as x86_64.

configs.description: One entry per configuration when the run has several (spine section 9.5): each repeats the fields that differ, such as argv, inputs, budget and outputs.

primary_config.description: The id of the configuration whose argv, exit code and verdict lines the top level repeats.

checks.description: Named pass/fail checks the recording script applied to the outputs.

ttl_days.description: Days until the run is stale, for a run that describes a moving upstream such as RUN-twin-pins (ARCHITECTURE.md section 18, item 15).

unrecorded.description: The core fields that are null because the execution did not record them, each with the reason. Required for every null core field of an imported record (GATE-runs).

notes.description: What a reader needs to judge the run: substitutions, emulations, caveats, differences from earlier runs.

runId.description: A run ID, RUN-{kebab}, such as RUN-tlc-doublespend.

runPath.description: A path relative to the repository root: . for the root, or segments of letters, digits and . _ @ + = , - joined by single slashes, with an optional trailing slash for a directory. No leading slash, no empty segment, and no segment that is . or .. A path outside the repository starts with a placeholder segment such as <sandbox> or <scratch> (private paths are never recorded); GATE-runs does not hash those.

input.description: A file the run read, located by a repository path, a URL or a file name, with its SHA-256 at execution time. A directory's sha256 is a manifest hash, named by sha256_method.

path.description: The file's path in the repository.

url.description: Where the file was downloaded from.

name.description: The file's name inside an archive or image, when it has no repository path.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file's bytes when the run read it.

role.description: What the run used the file for: spec, config, script, harness, fixture.

output.description: A file that holds output of the run, with its SHA-256 and size. GATE-runs fails when a file under runs/ no longer matches.

path.description: The file's path in the repository.

kind.description: What the file holds: a log, a trace, a report.

config.description: One configuration of a run with several. It repeats only the fields that differ from the top level.

id.description: The configuration's name, unique within the run.

origin.description: As origin at the top level, for this configuration.

argv.description: The exact command line of this configuration; empty when the configuration executed nothing (a file hashed, not run).

outputs.description: Output files of this configuration, as output records or as paths of files listed at the top level.

check.description: A named check on the run's outputs and whether it passed.

unrecorded.description: A core field that is null because the execution did not record it.

field.description: The field's name, such as argv or binary_sha256.

reason.description: Why the value is missing, and how it could be recovered.
